name: Arcane
_comment: cooks/biome-crystal.md 2.17 (nodes SPEC from the skill tree; numbers in tuning arcane.*, spells.<key>, wildbrands.<node>). Mana is a steady pool: 100 + 15 a Mana capacity rank, 6 a second at all times (Deep well x1.5, main path). Shields are one HP layer after guard (the bigger wins); Reflect throws reflectable shots back. Code: WRArcanePath (Mana, shields, Reflect, the passives, combos, the look), WRAbilitiesArcane (the nine abilities, runes, the Aegis dome, the Rune circle).
